title: Protection for Consumers of Fintech Platforms and Non-bank Institutions, and Regulations on Liquidity Levels and Responsible Marketing
what_it_is: Protection for Consumers of Fintech Platforms and Non-bank Institutions, and Regulations on Liquidity Levels and Responsible Marketing

sections.label: Investment platform asset safeguards
sections.summary: Platforms invest in funds managed by other licensed managers, must keep customer assets separate with licensed custodians, and withdrawals were redeemed orderly within three to six working days.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: They offer portfolios which are invested into funds managed by other licensed fund management companies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: These investment platforms are required by regulation to keep customers' assets legally separate and safekept by licensed custodians.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Customers' assets were properly segregated from the platform and requests for withdrawal were redeemed in an orderly manner, within the standard fund redemption timeframe of three to six working days.

sections.label: MAS review and customer caution
sections.summary: MAS is reviewing the case and how investment platforms implement requirements, and urges customers to understand product features and risks before investing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is reviewing this particular case against these requirements, as well as, more generally, how to ensure investment platforms implement these requirements effectively.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: At the same time, we urge customers to fully understand the features, including key terms and conditions, and risks of a financial product, before deciding to invest in it.

sections.label: Trust, innovation and risk management
sections.summary: The episode shows companies must have robust risk management practices and properly disclose product features, and the case will be reviewed with platforms and industry.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I think he made a really good point about the need to continue to foster trust and also to uphold innovation – and that is what we are trying to do with the fintech sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I think this particular episode has shown, in fact, that it is important for companies, and in fact, there are regulatory requirements, as I mentioned in my original reply for companies: first, to put in place these robust risk management practices; and second, to properly disclose their products and the features of their products as they impact the firm's operations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We will review this particular case in detail and work with platforms, work with the industry to ensure how to better implement these within these requirements that we have set out earlier on.

sections.label: Firm's CMSL fund management licence
sections.summary: The particular firm held a CMSL licence for fund management, which is one of the safeguards in this case.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: If you look at some of the safeguards for this particular case, this particular firm had a CMSL licence for fund management.

sections.label: Independent custody and orderly withdrawals
sections.summary: Customer funds under independent custody must remain intact under the CMSL licence and cannot be used to meet the firm's liabilities, enabling orderly withdrawals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: And that is why when customers are requesting for withdrawal, there is an orderly withdrawal because these customer funds are placed under independent custody.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: They must remain intact – it is a requirement under the CMSL licence – and they cannot be used to meet the firm's liability at any point of time.
